notes: Interactive four-stroke spark-ignition engine cutaway with thermodynamic cycle, crank-slider kinematics, cam-driven valves, spark ignition, particle flow, live pressure/torque/valve-lift graphs, what-if failures and parameters, exploded view, sound and hidden oil-jet detail. Single-file canvas app; reduced-motion and touch/keyboard supported. Thermodynamics uses a simplified filling-and-emptying model; values are physically plausible but not CFD-grade.
